title: LearnOps chapters (B6.2, v1)
description: The chapters.json file in a lesson folder (PRD B6.2): a bare JSON array of {start, end, title}. start and end are numbers of seconds from the beginning of the main track; fractional seconds are allowed. Gaps between chapters are allowed.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced by this file: that end is greater than start in the same entry (JSON Schema cannot compare two properties of one object); that the entries are in ascending order of start; that chapters do not overlap (an entry starts at or after the end of the one before); that every time is at most the manifest's duration_s (that value is in another file, so this is a consumer-level rule). These are checked by libs/contracts/lesson_files.py.

start.description: Seconds from the beginning of the main track, at least 0. Fractional seconds are allowed. Start of the chapter.

end.description: Seconds from the beginning of the main track, at least 0. Fractional seconds are allowed. End of the chapter; greater than start (validator rule).

title.description: The chapter title. Not empty and not only whitespace (at least one character other than whitespace). The mentor can edit it (FR-V-05).
